_note: PLACEHOLDER COPY — rewrite before any public release. All text original, written to the Understory voice rules (notices, never predicts; no advice verbs; ends in one question).

M00.general: A step off the map, taken lightly. You don't know how this goes, and just now that's the most honest thing about it.
M00.question: What would you try if being a beginner were allowed?

M01.general: Everything required is already on the table — attention, a few plain tools, a clear morning. The trick isn't magic; it's starting.
M01.question: Which tool in front of you is going unused?

M02.general: Not everything asks to be said out loud. Something in you already knows the shape of this and is waiting for you to stop talking over it.
M02.question: What do you already know that you haven't admitted to knowing?

M03.general: Things grow when tended, and mostly on their own schedule. This is a card of soil, meals, and other unglamorous plenty.
M03.question: What in your life is asking to be tended rather than fixed?

M04.general: Four walls, a fence line, a plan that holds. Structure gets a bad name until you notice how much can grow inside it.
M04.question: Where would a firmer edge make things kinder?

M05.general: The old ways got old by working, at least for someone. You're handling something inherited — a habit, a rule, a way of doing Sundays.
M05.question: Which inherited rule still fits you, and which is just familiar?

M06.general: A real choice, the kind that changes the chooser. Closeness has terms, and they're rarely written down.
M06.question: What are you actually choosing between?

M07.general: Motion, with your hands on the reins. Momentum is only useful when the direction is yours.
M07.question: Where is this speed taking you, and did you pick it?

M08.general: Not the loud kind of strong. The kind that waits out a snarl, keeps its voice level, opens its hand first.
M08.question: What responds to patience today that never responds to force?

M09.general: A deliberate step back, one small lantern, enough. Some questions only answer in a quiet room.
M09.question: What might you hear if you took an evening off from everyone?

M10.general: The wheel turns whether or not you push it. Some of this week is weather, not verdict.
M10.question: What part of this is simply the season it's in?

M11.general: Scales, held steady. Actions and their weights, seen plainly, without a thumb on the pan.
M11.question: What would an even-handed account of this look like?

M12.general: Hanging upside down is uncomfortable and very clarifying. The view has changed; you haven't moved.
M12.question: What looks different about this from the other way up?

M13.general: Something is over, and the tidy word for that is compost. Endings feed what comes next, though rarely on request.
M13.question: What are you still watering that's already done?

M14.general: Two vessels, one stream, poured slowly. Most good mixtures are boring to watch being made.
M14.question: What proportions are off by just a little?

M15.general: A bramble knot: nobody plants one, everybody grows one. Whatever binds here mostly binds because it's familiar.
M15.question: Which tangle do you keep because it's yours?

M16.general: Lightning is fast, and it mostly finds what was already tallest and driest. Something built has come down; the air is clearer than it's been.
M16.question: What has this collapse saved you from maintaining?

M17.general: After the storm, a thin bright constancy. Hope, in this deck, is a practice of small refills.
M17.question: What refills you a little, reliably?

M18.general: Half-light makes strange shapes out of ordinary fenceposts. Not everything you feel tonight is information.
M18.question: Which of these worries survives daylight?

M19.general: Plain warmth, nothing clever. A good thing is allowed to be exactly what it looks like.
M19.question: What's going well that you haven't said out loud?

M20.general: An old thing surfaces, asking to be re-read rather than re-lived. You've grown since you filed it.
M20.question: What deserves a second look from who you are now?

M21.general: A circle closes. Between this and the next thing there's a short interval called finished — easy to miss.
M21.question: What have you completed without pausing to notice?

wands-01.general: First green on the branch. An urge this fresh doesn't have a plan yet, and doesn't have to.
wands-01.question: What's the smallest first move?

wands-02.general: The gate is open and the map is in your hand. Wanting two horizons is normal; walking takes one.
wands-02.question: Which prospect keeps returning when you stop planning?

wands-03.general: You've done the sending; now comes the watching. Early returns say something, just not everything.
wands-03.question: What's actually in your hands while you wait?

wands-04.general: A threshold worth marking — flowers over the door. Small celebrations turn out to be load-bearing.
wands-04.question: What's worth marking this week, even briefly?

wands-05.general: Sticks crossed, voices raised, nobody quite fighting. Friction like this usually means everyone cares and no one has said about what.
wands-05.question: What is this contest actually about?

wands-06.general: A good day, publicly good. Taking credit gracefully is a skill, same as earning it.
wands-06.question: What praise are you deflecting instead of banking?

wands-07.general: The high ground, and you're holding it. Worth checking, now and then, that it's ground worth holding.
wands-07.question: What are you defending, and is it still yours?

wands-08.general: Everything in the air at once, all of it moving. Speed feels like progress; sometimes it even is.
wands-08.question: What's moving fast that deserves a slower look?

wands-09.general: Bruised, guarded, nearly through. The last stretch has a way of looking like the whole road.
wands-09.question: What would let you finish without going numb?

wands-10.general: Ten sticks, one back. Some of this load is yours; some you picked up because you happened to be passing.
wands-10.question: Which of these could be set down without anything breaking?

wands-page.general: A green shoot with opinions. Enthusiasm this young mostly wants permission and a little room.
wands-page.question: What are you curious about that you've been calling unproductive?

wands-knight.general: Off at a gallop, hat gone, grinning. Boldness covers distance; it's less good at corners.
wands-knight.question: Where does the dash serve you, and where does it just feel good?

wands-queen.general: Warmth that other people warm themselves at. Confidence worn like a garden — cultivated, not claimed.
wands-queen.question: Who gets the warmest version of you, and why them?

wands-king.general: The long view, with the sleeves still rolled up. Seasoned drive knows what to skip.
wands-king.question: What does the ten-year version of you keep, of all this?

cups-01.general: Something new is welling up, unasked. Feelings arrive before their explanations; that's the usual order.
cups-01.question: What are you feeling first and naming later?

cups-02.general: Two cups, level. An exchange this even is rare enough to notice while it's happening.
cups-02.question: Where in your life are the give and the take actually balanced?

cups-03.general: A shared table, everyone talking at once. Company turns out to be a staple, not a garnish.
cups-03.question: Who haven't you sat with lately, for no real reason?

cups-04.general: Three cups in reach and your eyes on the middle distance. Restlessness is information, just unsorted.
cups-04.question: What's being offered right now that you're looking past?

cups-05.general: Something spilled, and it mattered. The cups still standing are not a consolation prize; they're just also true.
cups-05.question: What remains, once the spill has been grieved?

cups-06.general: Memory with the sugar left in. The past is a good place to visit and famously poor soil for planting.
cups-06.question: What does this sweetness say about what you miss now?

cups-07.general: Seven doors, all ajar, none walked through. Options multiply when choosing feels expensive.
cups-07.question: Which of these possibilities are you actually prepared to feed?

cups-08.general: Leaving quietly, cups tidy behind you. Some departures aren't dramatic; they're just due.
cups-08.question: What have you outgrown that hasn't done anything wrong?

cups-09.general: A full cup and the sense to enjoy it. Contentment is allowed to be uncomplicated.
cups-09.question: What's enough, today, exactly as it is?

cups-10.general: Accord — the household kind, ordinary and unphotogenic. Fullness rarely announces itself; it hums.
cups-10.question: What ordinary arrangement of yours quietly works?

cups-page.general: A small message in a soft envelope. Whimsy is how feeling introduces itself politely.
cups-page.question: What small odd impulse have you been dismissing?

cups-knight.general: An approach, an offer, a flower held slightly too formally. Romance of any kind runs on nerve.
cups-knight.question: What invitation are you circling instead of answering?

cups-queen.general: Deep water, held calmly. You're carrying feelings today that aren't all yours.
cups-queen.question: Whose weather are you carrying?

cups-king.general: Feeling, banked and steady — a harbor with room in it. Composure isn't the absence of tide; it's practice with it.
cups-king.question: What lets you stay steady without going distant?

swords-01.general: One blade, new and exact. Clarity this sharp cuts both ways, so it rewards aim.
swords-01.question: What plain sentence have you been avoiding writing?

swords-02.general: Eyes closed, blades balanced, nobody moving. A stalemate is a decision too — the decision to hold still.
swords-02.question: What are you keeping undecided on purpose?

swords-03.general: Rain, and a truth that went in clean. Sharp things hurt in proportion to their accuracy.
swords-03.question: What did this hurt teach you that a kinder lesson couldn't?

swords-04.general: Blades hung up, lights low. Rest is a task with its own completion state.
swords-04.question: What would count as actual rest, not just stopping?

swords-05.general: Won, technically. The field is yours, and emptier than expected.
swords-05.question: What did this win cost, and who's counting?

swords-06.general: A crossing, low in the water, away from the noise. Moving on is quieter than it looks from shore.
swords-06.question: What are you ready to leave on the far bank?

swords-07.general: The quiet route, a few blades carried off. Strategy and slipperiness share a wardrobe.
swords-07.question: Where are you being clever when you could be clear?

swords-08.general: Fenced in by blades planted at arm's length — none of them touching you. Most of this enclosure is made of assumptions.
swords-08.question: Which of these limits have you tested lately?

swords-09.general: The 3 a.m. mind, rehearsing scenes that mostly never get performed. Worry is imagination with the lights off.
swords-09.question: Which worry deserves paper instead of another lap of the ceiling?

swords-10.general: Flat on the ground, thoroughly finished. There's a strange peace after an ending this complete: nothing left to defend.
swords-10.question: Now that it's done, what's no longer your job?

swords-page.general: All questions, quick eyes, notebook out. Watchfulness is wit before it's had practice.
swords-page.question: What are you observing closely, and is the observing standing in for acting?

swords-knight.general: Full tilt into the argument, reins somewhere behind. Speed of thought isn't the same as depth of it.
swords-knight.question: What case are you making faster than you're checking?

swords-queen.general: Candor with good posture. The dry eye sees clearly and still chooses its words.
swords-queen.question: What truth could you say plainly, and kindly, today?

swords-king.general: Principle, seated. A cool head is a tool; cold is just a temperature.
swords-king.question: Where does your fairness end and your distance begin?

pentacles-01.general: One seed, actual soil. Small beginnings hold up better than grand ones; they have less to prove.
pentacles-01.question: What tiny concrete thing could you plant today?

pentacles-02.general: Two coins in the air, tide coming in. Balance isn't a state; it's a verb, done continuously.
pentacles-02.question: What are you keeping aloft that could simply be put down?

pentacles-03.general: Good work, seen by people who know what they're looking at. Craft grows in company.
pentacles-03.question: Whose eye do you trust on your work, and have you shown them?

pentacles-04.general: A firm grip on what's yours. Past a certain tightness, keeping turns into clenching.
pentacles-04.question: What are you holding so tightly it can't be used?

pentacles-05.general: Cold outside a lit window. Lean seasons narrow the eyes, and they also mislead them — help tends to sit closer than it looks.
pentacles-05.question: What ask have you been too proud to make?

pentacles-06.general: Giving and getting, weighed out in the open. Generosity has bookkeeping, whether or not anyone admits it.
pentacles-06.question: In this exchange, which side of the scale are you on — and is that the usual side?

pentacles-07.general: Leaning on the hoe, counting pods. Slow growth looks exactly like nothing happening, from up close.
pentacles-07.question: What's genuinely growing that you keep re-measuring instead of trusting?

pentacles-08.general: The same small thing, again, slightly better. Repetition is how hands learn what heads already know.
pentacles-08.question: What are you practicing, whether you mean to or not?

pentacles-09.general: A tended garden with a gate that latches. From outside, ease reads as luck; the notebook says otherwise.
pentacles-09.question: What comfort have you earned and not yet enjoyed?

pentacles-10.general: The long house: roots, records, other people's plantings still bearing. Some wealth is measured in continuity.
pentacles-10.question: What are you building that outlasts your interest in it?

pentacles-page.general: Head down over the books, one seed pod saved as a specimen. Diligence is curiosity that shows up on schedule.
pentacles-page.question: What are you learning slowly and honestly?

pentacles-knight.general: The long row, hoed to the end. Thoroughness is unglamorous right up until it's the whole difference.
pentacles-knight.question: What gets finished if today holds only ordinary effort?

pentacles-queen.general: Provision, warm and practical — the kind that arrives before it's asked for. Care, in this suit, looks like handled logistics.
pentacles-queen.question: Who do you take care of by handling things, and do they know?

pentacles-king.general: Harvest in the barn, stewardship in the posture. Security kept in trust rather than in a fist.
pentacles-king.question: What resource of yours does the most good when shared?
